snippet.title: DI: Debt is Inevitable - Level 1 Showcase
snippet.description:
Here's 19 minutes of gameplay footage of my new upcoming game, DI: Debt is Inevitable, for your viewing pleasure.

pls ignore the placeholder sounds :)

Like what you see in this clip? Be sure to wishlist the game on steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2318300/DI_Debt_is_Inevitable/

Wanna support me and gain access to beta versions of DI? Check out my Patreon as well:
https://www.patreon.com/catoidi
